name: glassbox
description: Auditable local browser decisions with ranked alternatives.

interface.shortDescription: See the decision and strongest alternatives.
interface.longDescription: Use the local SwiftBrowse decision model to pick one next browser action. Each result includes the chosen action, its probability, and the top alternatives; these scores are model preferences, not explanations or guarantees.
defaultPrompt: Use GlassBox to decide the next action from this current page observation, then show the probability receipt.
Use GlassBox to inspect the top browser action candidates without executing one.
